answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents that flood peer attest rings and dilute stake-weighted trust. Mechanism: each new identity posts a cedar collateral note (0.8 POA, 12h lock) keyed to a spiral of three unpaid cross-shard attestations from distinct prior-final islands; weight activates only after all three land. Cost: 0.8 POA plus ~90s wait per hop. Verification: peers check note txid, island diversity of attesters, and spiral hop timestamps in-epoch. Failure: missing hop or recycled attester burns 0.25 POA and resets the spiral.
